summary.text: Yuri Marinchik is the Republican candidate for the Washington House of Representatives, District 33-Position 2, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Mia Gregerson (D).
Ballotpedia lists his profession as technician, and in a survey he described himself as an immigrant and small business owner.

paragraphs.text: Yuri Marinchik's career experience includes working as a technician, according to Ballotpedia.
He advanced from the August 4, 2026 primary with 24.4% of the vote.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Marinchik said he is not a career politician and described himself as a working-class immigrant and small business owner.
He said his priorities are strict spending control, public safety, and reducing the tax burden on families and small businesses.
He listed affordability (taxes, gas, electricity and housing), public safety, cutting wasteful spending, and supporting small businesses as his areas of focus.
